senses.definition_en: of or related to coronavirus

examples.english: Renovada Muerte is a book deserving a wide presence in the hands of the reading public. It is ideal for these days of coronavirus-related lockdown; and if we survive, to take with us on a beach vacation, where we can enjoy the stories with beer, mescal, and ceviche.
examples.ref: 2020, Ricardo Vigueras, “Renovada muerte, renovable vida [Renovada Muerte, renewable life]”, in Tema y Variaciones de Literatura, volume 54, page 296:
examples.text: La renovada muerte es un libro de referencia merecedor de larga presencia en manos del público lector. Ideal para estos días de claustro coronavírico; y si sobrevivimos, para llevar en las próximas vacaciones a una playa, donde disfrutar cada relato con cerveza helada, mezcalito y ceviche.
examples.translation: Renovada Muerte is a book deserving a wide presence in the hands of the reading public. It is ideal for these days of coronavirus-related lockdown; and if we survive, to take with us on a beach vacation, where we can enjoy the stories with beer, mescal, and ceviche.

examples.english: Much has changed in this coronavirus-year that has required us to adapt to a new lifestyle, such as greeting with our elbows in order to show affection but maintain social distance […]
examples.ref: 2020 July 6, “Cambiar la vida, cambiar la historia [Changing life, changing history]”, in A Quemaroppa (PDF), Gijón: Semana Negra, archived from the original on 20 Sep 2022, page 1:
examples.text: Ha cambiado mucho la vida este año coronavírico que nos ha obligado a adoptar nuevos hábitos de vida, como el de saludarse con el codo por aquello de ser afectuosos, pero manteniendo la distancia social[…]
examples.translation: Much has changed in this coronavirus-year that has required us to adapt to a new lifestyle, such as greeting with our elbows in order to show affection but maintain social distance […]

examples.english: She came very close, just one step away, but lost in the quarter-finals—twice at Wimbledon and twice more in New York, all four between 2018 and 2019—and the stoppage due to coronavirus destroyed much of her remaining reputation.
examples.ref: 2022 June 28, Alejandro Ciriza Istúriz, “Serena Williams, de mazazo en mazazo [Serena Williams, from blow to blow]”, in El País, Miami:
examples.text: Estuvo muy cerca, a un solo paso, pero volaron esas cuatro finales—dos en Wimbledon y otras dos en Nueva York, las cuatro entre 2018 y 2019—y el parón coronavírico dilapidó gran parte del crédito que le quedaba.
examples.translation: She came very close, just one step away, but lost in the quarter-finals—twice at Wimbledon and twice more in New York, all four between 2018 and 2019—and the stoppage due to coronavirus destroyed much of her remaining reputation.
